en.bdb: Conduct of a Sikh of the Guru

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਿਬ ਦਿਸਟਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਸਿਖ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: dhib dhisaT gur dhiaan dhar sikh viralaa koiee|

en.bdb: Rare is the gurmukh  who concentrates upon the Guru and attains the divine sight.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਾਰਖੂ ਹੋਇ ਕੈ ਰਤਨਾ ਅਵਲੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ratan paarakhoo hoi kai ratanaa avaloiee|

en.bdb: He is the jeweller having the capacity of testing as well as keeping the jewels in the from of virtues.
His mind becomes pure like ruby and he remains absorbed in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਮਾਲ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਜਗਿ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: ratan maal gursikh jag gurmat gun goiee|

en.bdb: His mind becomes pure like ruby and he remains absorbed in the holy congregation.

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੀਵਦਿਆਂ ਮਰਿ ਅਮਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮੋਈ।
verses.translit_en: jeevadhiaa(n) mar amar hoi sukh sahaj samoiee|

en.bdb: He is dead while being alive i.e. he turns his face from evil propensities.

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਜਾਣੋਈ ॥੭॥
verses.translit_en: ot pot jotee jot mil jaanai jaanoiee ||7||

en.bdb: Totally merging himself in the supreme light he understands his self as well as the Lord.
